articles.title: Meet Kyutai REKI: The 2.4B VLA Model Bringing Efficient Memory to Robot Manipulation
articles.summary: Kyutai, with Inria and École des Ponts, released REKI, a 2.4B-parameter vision-language-action model for robot manipulation pretrained only on public data. The model uses a low-cost cached memory mechanism for recent frames, improving benchmark performance and reducing robot arm oscillation, with weights available on Hugging Face under a non-commercial license.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is a concrete robotics AI development showing progress in smaller, more efficient models for physical-world task execution. It highlights potential second-order demand for AI compute infrastructure while also signaling that commercial monetization remains early, given the non-commercial license and benchmark-focused deployment.
